about: Kawartha Lakes is a single-tier city in Ontario covering the former Victoria County, a large rural territory of lakes, farms, and villages. Lindsay is the main urban centre; Fenelon Falls, Bobcaygeon, and many shoreline hamlets sit on the Trent–Severn Waterway. Despite the “city” legal name, most of the municipality is countryside. About 79,000 people live in Kawartha Lakes.
seoSummary: Rural Ontario municipality of lakes and villages, with Lindsay as the main town on the Trent–Severn.
knownFor: Former Victoria County amalgamated as a lower-density “city”
